summary: The official Assam Government/NIC BhuNaksha viewer was verified and its public hierarchy resolves Sonitpur district to Tezpur circle and four Tezpur urban village candidates. One village capabilities response exposed EPSG:32646 and a parcel-map extent. Anonymous click-info repeatedly failed inside the backend and GetFeatureInfo returned 400, so no stable parcel identity or geometry is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Assamese discovery queries and their actual first-party URLs are recorded in city-11971-tezpur.json.
requestOutcomes: Public landing page, current JavaScript, auth-key bootstrap, district/circle/village hierarchy, one WMS capabilities response, click-info attempts and WMS GetFeatureInfo were recorded. No login, credentials, private token retention, CAPTCHA bypass, unsafe field request or global TLS disable was used.
